title: Howard Hughes visiting George Van Tassel at Giant Rock

tellings.quote: George Van Tassel used to have Howard Hughes land on his private airirstrip and come eat his wife's ties.

plain: In the 1950s, the story goes, the aviator and billionaire Howard Hughes used to land on George Van Tassel's private airstrip at Giant Rock in the California desert and eat his wife's pies. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this without a named source, and the book Closer Encounters is credited for it. It is told to tie a famous figure in aviation to Van Tassel's desert airstrip.
